2026-2645-3147-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3147-3430.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1115-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3899-6566--5--195.easyPrerequisites: At least one persist creature has any type of counter on it.
3899-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-6559.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

225-757-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

3858-7326.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Casey Jones by paying {4}, doubling its power until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until Casey Jones has power 19 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
3858-7326.notes: The mana needed varies based on Casey Jones' power when starting the combo. {16} assumes it has a power of 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5243-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3713-4289-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1331-3916.easyPrerequisites: Scythe of the Wretched attached to Ashling the Pilgrim.
1331-3916.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Ashling the Pilgrim deathtouch.
1331-3916.description:
Give Ashling the Pilgrim deathtouch by any method.
Activate Ashling the Pilgrim three times by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}, putting three +1/+1 counters on it, then removing all +1/+1 counters from it and dealing that much damage to each creature.
Each creature dealt damage by Ashling the Pilgrim dies due to Ashling the Pilgrim's deathtouch.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers for each creature that dies this way, returning them to the battlefield under your control, ensuring that Ashling the Piglrim is returned last so that Scythe of the Wretched will be attached to it.
You may repeat this combo as desired.

539-4050-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

681-5414-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5414-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3053-5089.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-5089.description:
Animate Prismatic Geoscope using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2018-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3372-4089-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Glasspool Mimic
3372-4089-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

7-997-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-997-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-997-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-997-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2825-3469.easyPrerequisites: Energy Arc exiled by Elite Arcanist.
2825-3469.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2825-3469.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Energy Arc and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

524-1167-1927.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

745-2092-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
745-2092-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2316-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
851-2316-4050.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1269-4867-5231.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Cormela, adding {R}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Exhume by paying {1}{B}, causing each player to return a creature card from their graveyard to the battlefield, with you choosing to return Cormela.
Repeat.

2450-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other black creatures.
2450-4619.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U}, changing all instances of "white" on Teysa to "black".
Activate Teysa by sacrificing three black creatures, targeting any creature.
The creatures die, triggering Teysa three times, creating three 1/1 black Spirit creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1967-2440-4720.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
1967-2440-4720.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {3}{R}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1812-2034-2577.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1518-1987-2556-4792.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-2556-4792.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

2363-2882-4675.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2363-2882-4675.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
